None of the three answers matches what I recall for this result. I believe the set is the primes where X_0(p) has genus zero, {2, 3, 5, 7, 13}, which sums to 30. Solution 2 found the right criterion but missed p = 13, since X_0(13) has genus 0. Solution 1 (answer 2) and Solution 3 (answer 10) rest on unsupported claims. I could not verify the set against the source paper, so my confidence is moderate.
